title: Add Beacon bounce webhooks and settings support
author: casey-dev
description:
Beacon Relay is a mail relay with a small webhook API. This adds it as a bounce provider next to Sendgrid and Postmark.

Beacon sends a handshake first and then batches of delivery reports. Its docs are thin on the `messageRef` field (the Message-ID header), so I match bounces by recipient email only. On my test account that worked.

Is there anything I should do differently, or explain better in the docs?
